title: Workbench Framework Capability Contract
description: Schema for framework.yaml self-description files. Each framework declares what capabilities it exposes, how the Workbench should render them, and what evidence it requires.

display_name.description: Human-readable name shown in Workbench UI.

version.description: Semantic version of the framework contract.

description.description: Short description of what the framework does.

capabilities.description: Diagnostic capabilities this framework exposes to the Workbench.

value_path.description: Dot-separated path into framework_output.json, e.g. 'advanced.sigma_t' or 'basic.overall'.

render.description: How the Workbench should render this capability.

severity.description: For gauge and alert renders: severity threshold bands.

alert_condition.description: For alert render: expression that triggers the alert (e.g. 'value == "yes"').

display.description: Templates controlling how the framework's output is rendered in Workbench surfaces.

basic_card_header.description: Header line template. Use {field} placeholders resolved against framework_output.basic.

basic_check.description: How the Workbench computes the basic check summary from the framework's output.

overall_from.description: Dot-path to the overall status value, e.g. 'basic.overall'.

main_pressure_from.description: Dot-path to the main pressure value, e.g. 'basic.main_pressure'.

confidence_from.description: Dot-path to the confidence value, e.g. 'basic.confidence'.

summary_from.description: Dot-path to the summary text, e.g. 'basic.summary'.

required_evidence.description: Evidence series this framework needs from Data Providers.

optional.description: If true, the framework can still function without this series.

fallback.description: Alternative series_id to use if primary is unavailable.

label.description: Display label for the evidence panel.

area.description: Category grouping for the evidence panel (e.g. 'Rates volatility').

raw_output.description: Describes where the framework publishes raw output (for frameworks that don't produce framework_output.json directly).

summary_md.description: Path to executive summary markdown, relative to the framework's output root.

dashboard_json.description: Path to dashboard snapshot JSON, relative to the framework's output root.

main_signal_heading.description: Markdown heading that starts the main signal section (e.g. '## Main Signal').

entrypoints.description: CLI entrypoints the framework exposes for running analysis.

outputs.description: Output paths relative to the framework root.
